title: Shaders that join the native controls and the video frame
blurb: One <video controls> gives a WebGL canvas its controls and its frame as two textures. The controls bend, melt into and light the picture, and the page finds where the play button and timeline are without script access to them.
question: Can one shader work on the native controls and the video frame as separate inputs, and can an effect start at one control when no script can reach it?
result: Yes. The controls and the frame are two textures from one element. Each named part is found by giving it a flat colour for one paint and reading the picture back.
